korea_annex.instrument: Enforcement Rule of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act, Annex 1 (List of Endangered Wildlife)

gbif_backbone.title: GBIF Backbone Taxonomy
gbif_backbone.citation: GBIF Secretariat (2023). GBIF Backbone Taxonomy. Checklist dataset https://doi.org/10.15468/39omei

schema_notes.id: Record identifier: registry code (16-species file) or kd-<taxon>-<grade>-<annex row number> (census).
schema_notes.korean_name: Korean vernacular name as used on the card (16-species file) or as printed in Annex 1 (census).
schema_notes.scientific_name: Binomial used for GBIF matching and occurrence counts. For a taxon designated below species rank the designated name is in korea_statute_scientific_name.
schema_notes.english_name: English vernacular name (16-species file); null in the census.
schema_notes.taxon_group: Taxonomic group as labelled in the species registry or in Annex 1.
schema_notes.name_provisional: true when the card gives only a Korean vernacular that maps to more than one taxon and the scientific name was assigned by the authors.
schema_notes.korea_nie_grade: National grade under Annex 1 (I급 = Class I, II급 = Class II); null when the species carries no national designation. The name is kept for compatibility with v1.0.0 and v1.0.1; the grade is set by statute, not by the National Institute of Ecology. Identical to korea_statutory_grade.
schema_notes.korea_statutory_grade: Alias of korea_nie_grade under a name that says what the value is (added in v1.0.2). New code should read this field.
schema_notes.korea_grade_source: statute_verified = matched by machine against the text of Annex 1 of the Enforcement Rule of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act (as amended 2022-12-09); api = a machine-readable government endpoint (none exists at release; reserved); statute_transcribed = typed in by hand, refused by the packaging gate; none = the species carries no national designation.
schema_notes.korea_statute_korean_name: Korean name as printed in the matched Annex 1 row.
schema_notes.korea_statute_scientific_name: Scientific name as printed in the matched Annex 1 row, with word spacing restored; may be a subspecies or variety.
schema_notes.statute_rank: Rank of the designated taxon: species | subspecies | variety | form; null when there is no national designation.
schema_notes.iucn_category: Red List category code of the selected assessment; null when none was returned. Under matched_at_species_rank it is the category of the species, not of the designated subspecies or variety.
schema_notes.iucn_source: iucn_api_v4 = category retrieved by a direct IUCN Red List API v4 call; iucn_via_gbif = category from the token-free GBIF redistribution of the Red List (DOI 10.15468/0qnb58, CC BY 4.0), which carries no habitat, threat or action codes; iucn_none_returned = no category was returned on the retrieval date (see iucn_match_status for why; called iucn_not_assessed before v1.0.2); registry_reference = a reference value used for checking only, refused by the packaging gate.
schema_notes.iucn_match_status: API path: matched = IUCN taxon found under the designated name and assessed; matched_via_synonym = found under another name (iucn_query_name) reached through the GBIF Backbone accepted name or its synonyms, including infraspecific synonyms; matched_at_species_rank = the designated taxon is a subspecies or variety and only its species has an assessment; not_assessed = an IUCN taxon exists but has no published assessment; name_unresolved = no IUCN taxon under any name tried; via_unaccepted_gbif_match = the IUCN taxon was reached only through a name derived from a GBIF match outside the gate (FUZZY or HIGHERRANK), so any category is recorded but never compared, not even in the any-concept fields; no_current_assessment = the IUCN taxon has assessments but none is marked latest, so no category is recorded (the past assessments are listed in warnings; since v1.0.4 a designated subspecies or variety in that position falls back to its species, as one with no assessment does, and no census record carries this value). Token-free path: matched_via_gbif = a Global category found in the GBIF copy of the Red List; no_global_category_via_gbif = the Backbone match passed the gate but the checklist has no Global category (HTTP 204, empty body or NOT_EVALUATED); name_unresolved_via_gbif = no Backbone match, or a match outside the gate.
schema_notes.iucn_query_name: Name under which the IUCN taxon was found; null when none was found.
schema_notes.iucn_concept_relation: Relation of the unit the IUCN assessed to the designated taxon. same = the same taxon (only spelling, genus placement or rank notation differ); broader = the IUCN unit is wider: a species assessment used for a designated subspecies or variety (including a genus transfer, wider by rank only: Glaux maritima var. obtusifolia -> Lysimachia maritima, Acoptolabrus leechi yooni -> Carabus leechi), or a designated species that the GBIF Backbone treats as a synonym of another species (merge: Kirengeshoma koreana -> K. palmata, Habenaria flagellifera -> Peristylus densus, Pedicularis hallaisanensis -> P. verticillata); uncertain = the relation cannot be established: Arctous rubra -> A. erythrocarpa (reached as a synonym of the designated name, so the IUCN unit may be the same or narrower), or the Global assessment's range countries include neither KR nor KP (range check, v1.0.4: Brasenia schreberi, Ellobium chinense, Michelia compressa -> Magnolia compressa, Utricularia yakusimensis -> U. uliginosa, Lethenteron japonicus -> L. camtschaticum), or checked by hand (v1.0.6: Dryophytes suweonensis, whose IUCN assessment covers only the populations north of the Chilgap range after the southern ones were described as D. flaviventris, while Annex 1 names D. suweonensis alone; the 2022 amendment, which postdates that description, did not list D. flaviventris, so the IUCN unit is likely narrower in taxonomic concept; geographically the two only partly overlap, since the IUCN unit adds KP and omits the southern KR populations; this is not established); different_taxon = checked by hand and found to be another taxon (Lycoris chinensis var. sinuolata -> L. uydoensis; and, found by the range check, Strix aluco, whose Korean population the IUCN places in S. nivicolum, and Phoxinus phoxinus, which the IUCN restricts to western Europe). null = no IUCN taxon found. Inferred from the name pair, the resolution route and the range countries, with hand overrides (iucn_relation_basis says which); these fifteen are all the census records whose relation is not same, apart from designated subspecies and varieties that reached the assessment of their own binomial. The same rules are applied on the token-free path, where no range countries are available (there Dryophytes suweonensis reaches D. immaculatus through the GBIF Backbone synonymy, which the Backbone took from its constituent Catalogue of Life (in the Annual Checklist 2023, ChecklistBank 9910, from the ITIS sector; which reference ITIS then cited is not recoverable; Dufresnes et al. 2016 had proposed a synonymy of the two names); the IUCN and Borzee et al. 2018 and 2020 treat the two as separate species, as do ITIS and the Catalogue of Life now, and the record is different_taxon under the IUCN's concept).
schema_notes.iucn_relation_basis: Where iucn_concept_relation came from (v1.0.6). inferred = derived by rule from the name pair and the resolution route; range_check = lowered by rule to uncertain because the Global assessment's range countries include neither KR nor KP; hand_override = set by hand after checking the literature and the assessment text (Lycoris chinensis var. sinuolata, Strix aluco, Phoxinus phoxinus, Dryophytes suweonensis; on the token-free path also Dryophytes suweonensis -> D. immaculatus). null when there is no relation. The packaging gate checks the value against the override tables of common/iucn_resolve.py. It marks hand decisions on the relation only. One further hand decision changes no relation, grade or divergence value: the IUCN taxon of Panthera tigris altaica was read by a hand-checked SIS identifier for the warning text (warning code iucn_taxon_hand_mapped; the relation, broader at species rank, is inferred). To exclude every record touched by a hand decision, use two conditions: iucn_relation_basis = hand_override, or iucn_taxon_hand_mapped among the warning codes.
schema_notes.iucn_range_includes_korea: true when the range country list (locations) of the selected assessment includes KR or KP with any presence code, extinct and possibly extinct included; false when the list exists and includes neither; null when there is no category, no country list, or the value came from the token-free path. A Global assessment with false is never compared (iucn_concept_relation uncertain or different_taxon), and the packaging gate checks this. A European regional assessment is false by construction and is already excluded by its scope. A token-free value that is compared carries the warning iucn_range_not_checked, and the packaging gate checks that too.
schema_notes.iucn_counterpart: Object, only for a record whose relation is different_taxon because the range check found a split (Strix aluco, Phoxinus phoxinus); null otherwise. Gives the IUCN taxon that corresponds to the Korean population, as checked by hand on 2026-09-26 through the IUCN Red List API v4; subfields are glossed under iucn_counterpart.*. The counterpart's category is not compared with the national grade in either divergence field.
schema_notes.iucn_counterpart.name: IUCN taxon name of the counterpart; null when none was identified.
schema_notes.iucn_counterpart.sis_taxon_id: IUCN SIS taxon identifier of the counterpart.
schema_notes.iucn_counterpart.assessment_id: Assessment identifier of the counterpart's latest Global assessment.
schema_notes.iucn_counterpart.category: Red List category of that assessment.
schema_notes.iucn_counterpart.range_includes_korea: Whether that assessment lists KR or KP among its range countries.
schema_notes.iucn_counterpart.basis: How the counterpart was identified, or why none was.
schema_notes.iucn_scope: Scope of the selected assessment, e.g. Global or Europe. Selection prefers the latest Global assessment and falls back to the latest assessment of any scope only when no Global one exists.
schema_notes.iucn_assessment_id: Assessment identifier. API path: assessment_id of the Red List API v4. Token-free path: the number after 'A' in the assessment DOI cited by the GBIF checklist; same numbering, but the checklist can cite an earlier assessment than the API's latest.
schema_notes.iucn_assessment_date: Assessment date (YYYY-MM-DD) as given in the assessment record.
schema_notes.iucn_assessment_year: Year the assessment was published in the Red List (int).
schema_notes.iucn_assessment_outdated: true when the assessment date (or, if absent, the end of the publication year) is more than 10 years before the IUCN retrieval date, the age at which the Red List treats an assessment as needing an update; null when there is no category.
schema_notes.iucn_retrieved_between_utc: UTC retrieval window of the IUCN responses read for this record, including responses for names that returned nothing.
schema_notes.iucn_population_trend: Population trend of the selected assessment (API path only).
schema_notes.iucn_habitats: Habitat classification labels of the selected assessment (API path only).
schema_notes.iucn_threats: Threat classification labels of the selected assessment (API path only).
schema_notes.iucn_conservation_actions: Conservation-action labels of the selected assessment (API path only).
schema_notes.no_global_assessment: true when iucn_scope is not Global (regional-only or no assessment).
schema_notes.mismatch_flag: true when severity_gap is non-zero, false when it is zero; null when mismatch_type is not_comparable or null.
schema_notes.mismatch_type: korea_stricter | iucn_stricter | aligned = sign of severity_gap; not_comparable = the species has a national grade but no Global category on the ordinal scale for the same taxon (DD, NE, regional-only, none returned, iucn_concept_relation other than same, which includes a Global range without KR or KP, or an iucn_match_status other than matched, matched_via_synonym or matched_via_gbif); null = no national grade.
schema_notes.severity_gap: severity(national) - severity(IUCN) on the display scale EX 8, EW 7, CR 6, EN 5, VU 4, NT 3, LC 2; Class I 6, Class II 4. DD and NE are not on the scale. Interpretable in sign and relative magnitude only; do not average, sum or treat as an interval.
schema_notes.mismatch_type_any_concept: mismatch_type computed without the same-taxon condition: a species-rank or merged-synonym (broader) category is compared with the national grade as if it applied to the designated taxon. Values reached through a GBIF match outside the gate, and relations uncertain or different_taxon, stay not_comparable. Reported so that both readings are available; the primary field is mismatch_type.
schema_notes.severity_gap_any_concept: severity_gap under the rule of mismatch_type_any_concept.
schema_notes.gbif_usage_key: GBIF Backbone usageKey of the match of scientific_name.
schema_notes.gbif_accepted_name: Accepted scientific name for that usageKey in the GBIF Backbone.
schema_notes.gbif_match_type: GBIF Backbone matchType. The packaging gate refuses any 16-species record whose match is not EXACT at rank SPECIES or SUBSPECIES unless flagged in the species registry; in the census such matches are kept and carry gbif_match_accepted = false.
schema_notes.gbif_rank: Rank of the GBIF Backbone match.
schema_notes.gbif_match_accepted: true when the GBIF match is EXACT at rank SPECIES or SUBSPECIES. IUCN values reached through names derived from a match with false carry iucn_match_status = via_unaccepted_gbif_match.
schema_notes.gbif_habitats: GBIF species-profile habitat labels (16-species file); empty in the census.
schema_notes.gbif_realm: GBIF species-profile realm flags (16-species file); empty object in the census.
schema_notes.gbif_occurrence_kr: GBIF occurrence count with country=KR (16-species file); null in the census.
schema_notes.gbif_occurrence_total: GBIF occurrence count, unfiltered (16-species file); null in the census.
schema_notes.gbif_countries: Countries in the GBIF occurrence facet, by count (16-species file); empty in the census.
schema_notes.gbif_source: Per-species provenance of all gbif_* fields (object; subfields glossed under gbif_source.*). Filled in both files; in the census it covers name matching only.
schema_notes.gbif_source.api: GBIF API version and host queried.
schema_notes.gbif_source.backbone: Taxonomy the name was matched against (GBIF Backbone Taxonomy).
schema_notes.gbif_source.kingdom_hint: Kingdom passed to the GBIF name matcher; null means no hint (seaweeds, whose kingdom differs between groups).
schema_notes.gbif_source.retrieved_between_utc: UTC retrieval window [first, last] of the cached GBIF responses read for this record.
schema_notes.gbif_source.occurrence_basis: 16-species file only: how the occurrence counts and the country list were obtained.
schema_notes.gbif_source.use: Census only: states that GBIF was used for name matching and synonym resolution, not for occurrence aggregation.
schema_notes.card: BonV Lab card narrative (object; 16-species file; null in the census). Subfields are glossed under card.*. A disagreement between the printed grade and the statute is preserved in card.grade_printed_on_card and written to warnings.
schema_notes.card.card_id: Identifier of the card in the BonV Lab card set.
schema_notes.card.habitat: Habitat text printed on the card (Korean).
schema_notes.card.diet: Diet text printed on the card (Korean).
schema_notes.card.ecological_role: Ecological-role text printed on the card (Korean).
schema_notes.card.observation_points: Observation cues printed on the card (Korean).
schema_notes.card.threats: Threat factors printed on the card (Korean).
schema_notes.card.story_questions: Open-ended classroom questions printed on the card (Korean).
schema_notes.card.grade_printed_on_card: National grade as printed on the card (I급 or II급), kept as printed even where it differs from the statute.
schema_notes.warnings: Build-time provenance and consistency notes: a list of objects with a machine code and a Korean message (subfields glossed under warnings[].*).
schema_notes.warnings[].code: Machine-readable warning code. Values: card_grade_differs_from_statute = The grade printed on the card differs from the statutory grade.; card_narrative_missing = No card narrative was found for this species.; gbif_match_outside_gate = The GBIF Backbone match is not EXACT at rank SPECIES or SUBSPECIES.; gbif_request_failed = A GBIF request failed during the build.; gbif_values_species_rank = The statute designates a subspecies or variety; GBIF values are for the species.; iucn_assessment_outdated = The assessment is more than ten years older than the IUCN retrieval date.; iucn_category_differs_from_registry = The retrieved IUCN category differs from the reference value in the species registry.; iucn_category_not_on_scale = The category (DD or NE) is not on the ordinal scale; no divergence is computed.; iucn_concept_broader = The designated species is a synonym of another species in the GBIF Backbone (merge), so the IUCN unit is wider; mismatch_type is not_comparable and the any-concept fields compare it.; iucn_concept_rank_only = The IUCN unit is the species of a designated subspecies or variety, reached after a genus transfer; wider only by rank.; iucn_concept_different_taxon = The name reached at the IUCN belongs to a different taxon (checked by hand); nothing is compared.; iucn_concept_uncertain = The relation between the IUCN unit and the designated taxon cannot be established from the names.; iucn_matched_at_species_rank = Only the species of a designated subspecies or variety is assessed; no divergence is computed.; iucn_matched_via_synonym = The IUCN assesses the taxon under another name (iucn_query_name).; iucn_name_unresolved = No IUCN taxon was found under any name tried.; iucn_no_current_assessment = The IUCN taxon has assessments but none is marked latest; no category is recorded.; iucn_no_global_category_via_gbif = The GBIF copy of the Red List has no Global category (token-free path).; iucn_not_assessed = An IUCN taxon exists but has no published assessment.; iucn_range_excludes_korea = The range country list of the Global assessment contains neither KR nor KP; the IUCN unit may not include the Korean population, so nothing is compared.; iucn_range_not_checked = The IUCN value came from the token-free path, which has no range countries, so no range check was made; a species-concept split (as for Strix aluco) would go undetected. Check the range by hand or withhold the comparison.; iucn_regional_assessment = The category comes from a regional assessment, not a Global one; it is not compared with the national grade (see iucn_scope).; iucn_taxon_hand_mapped = The IUCN taxon of the designated subspecies is not returned by a name search and was read by a hand-checked SIS identifier (Panthera tigris altaica, SIS 15956); only the warning text depends on it.; iucn_token_missing = No IUCN API token was set; only the token-free path was used.; iucn_via_unaccepted_gbif_match = The IUCN result came only through a name derived from a GBIF match outside the gate; not compared.; statute_grade_differs_from_transcription = The statutory grade differs from the hand-transcribed seed value; the statute is used.; statute_grade_transcribed = The national grade is a hand transcription not yet checked against the annex.
schema_notes.warnings[].message_ko: Human-readable message in Korean, with the values involved.
